comment: baseline_total is a heuristic ceiling, in TOKEN units, on words-large-v3-ar-6da1b0b4.json: it is the wrong-token count measured there for each term (right was 0 for every term on that reference run, so right+wrong == wrong there — that coincidence is what let a wrong-unit ceiling look correct for six of seven terms and hide the bug on the seventh). `right` counts OCCURRENCES of the expected term, not tokens, so a term whose wrong spelling is split across multiple tokens ("جونيورز" mangled to "وناشوا نيورز": 2 wrong tokens, 1 right occurrence once fixed) makes baseline_total and right structurally incomparable units. terms_invented is therefore advisory only (printed, not gated) — see the comment on _WORSE_IF_UP in score_transcript.py.
